factors.label: Price vs pack value

factors.label: Last 30 days
factors.desc: Price change over the 30 days before.

factors.label: Distance from high
factors.desc: How far below its all-time high it was.

factors.label: Cheapest listing vs market
factors.desc: Lowest ask ÷ market price. Below 1 = sellers undercutting.

screens.title: Passes every filter that held up
screens.why: Past the new-release decay (6+ months), priced under 30% above its packs, the cheapest listing is at or below market, and not falling over 30 days.

screens.title: Boxes trading below pack value
screens.why: Over a year old and cheaper sealed than the 36 packs inside. Relative value, not a timing signal: this edge was strong in the bull market and faded to average in the latest window.

screens.title: Avoid: priced 60%+ above its packs
screens.why: The one warning that held in every market and under every entry price. These lagged the market every period we checked.
